title: Read public evidence query fields
responsibility: Reconstruct approved evidence query fields and bind the project from the route.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceQuery.request
inputs.description: Request URL containing evidence query parameters.

inputs.name: hubEvidenceQuery.projectId
inputs.description: Authorized route project ID to use.

inputs.name: hubArtifactQuery.request
inputs.description: Request URL containing artifact query parameters.

inputs.name: hubArtifactQuery.projectId
inputs.description: Authorized route project ID to use.

outputs.name: hubEvidenceQuery
outputs.description: Validated public entity-evidence query with the route project ID.

outputs.name: hubArtifactQuery
outputs.description: Validated public artifact query with the route project ID and absent viewport/notes/evidence revisions supplied as null.
